name: Ananta Ripa Ajmera
reason: Health restore, re-read 12 Nov 2026 under the new rule: still out. Her own site (theancientway.co, robots allows) now sells much of her work on treating conditions: 'Ayurveda Lifestyle Medicine for Cancer Survivors' (/ayurveda-cancer), 'Take Health Into Your Own Hands' ($1,499, for people with chronic health challenges, to 'manage symptoms'), and the Ayurveda Lifestyle Coach Training framed as 'Ayurveda Lifestyle Medicine' for people who have 'received a diagnosis' and as root-cause healing with diet ('the right foods'), which is also a diet programme. The Hero's Journey programme is pitched to people who have 'done the therapy… but still feel stuck', close to the 'better than therapy' line. What would pass cleanly is thin: The Circle of Life community (interview to join, no price), a free chakra quiz and The Way of the Goddess book (ISBN only behind amzn.to links); her YouTube is almost all Shorts and no base is published. Contact would be info@theancientway.co (mailto on /ayurveda-cancer). Owner may revisit if a Way-of-the-Goddess-only listing is wanted. Restored from docs/content-audits/pipelines-sprint-3/skipped/ananta-ripa-ajmera.json.
